select CM.club_no, CM.account_id, CM.club_member_role, CM.club_member_join, A.account_nickname as accountNickname, A.attachment_no as attachmentNo
from club_member CM inner join account A on CM.account_id = A.account_id where CM.club_no = #{clubNo} order by case when CM.club_member_role = '모임장' then 1 when CM.club_member_role = '임원' then 2 else 3 end, CM.club_member_join asc
